provenance.page: Full served JavaScript/JSDOM and actual ASGI TestClient/SQLite; static asset response SHA checked by original pytest against snapshot input
provenance.requests: Page recorded API attempts; one controlled before-send synthetic failure has no server response. Fixture revoke command API replies are asserted, not separate browser fetch records
provenance.workers: Worker objects use same Store, not process restart; only synthetic Mock/Scripted model objects
provenance.sql: Original saved SQL trace text from each of three endpoint requests for each parent-output/child-output case after controlled stored receipt damage and Grant withdrawal
provenance.attempts: DB ledger state counts are not a separately instrumented total of provider calls
provenance.input_copies: Snapshot is reconstructible Git input, excluded from raw output manifest; exact Gitblob/SHA/size indices retained
